# Vendored arrayref 0.3.9

This directory contains the runtime source from the previously locked
`arrayref 0.3.9` crate. Its crates.io archive checksum is
`76a2e8124351fda1ef8aaaa3bbd7ebbcb486bbcd4225aca0aa0d84bb2db8fecb`.

All legitimate registry releases were yanked on 2026-08-20. The newly
published 0.3.10 release introduced a dependency on the nonexistent
`proc-macro1` package, so Lichen does not consume it. The workspace patch is a
temporary supply-chain containment measure and must be removed only after an
upstream release is independently reviewed and passes the full release gates.
